definition_en: a piece of clothing worn around the waist, or to go around something
core_image: 蓝色长裙在晚风里轻轻摆动
scene: 她穿了一条蓝色的长裙去参加晚会。She wore a long blue skirt to the party.

senses.title: The piece of clothing

senses.title: The outer edge

examples.cn: 树枝在重压下啪地断了。

examples.en: The dog snapped at the fly.
examples.cn: 狗猛地去咬那只苍蝇。

examples.en: She snapped a photo of the bridge.
examples.cn: 她给那座桥拍了张快照。

dict_mnemonic.text: snap 与 snip、nap、slap 形近；snap a photo 是「拍快照」，cold snap 是「寒潮」。

root: 经中古低地德语 snappen（迅速咬住）进入英语，核心义「突然而短促的动作」。

sensesIntro.en: Snap means to break sharply, bite, photograph quickly, or speak angrily.
sensesIntro.cn: snap 指啪地折断、猛咬、快速拍照，或生气地说话。

core.en: A sudden event with a sharp edge.
core.cn: 带有尖利感的突然事件。

branches.en: A branch gives way.
Jaws close in a moment.
A shutter records a second.
An angry voice cuts the air.
Breaking and scolding share a sharp sound.
branches.cn: 折断与斥责共享一种尖利声响。

intro.en: Snap builds words for sudden breaks and quick shots.
intro.cn: snap 构成表示突然断裂和快速拍摄的词。

latinIntro.en: Snap is Germanic in origin, not Latin.
latinIntro.cn: snap 源自日耳曼语，不是拉丁语。

items.example: The rope will snap if you pull.
The string snapped in the wind.
The fire was snapping and crackling.
He took a snapshot of the square.
The case has a snap-on lid.

items.meaning: a short period of very cold weather
items.example: A cold snap killed the young plants.

definition_en: soft white flakes that fall from clouds in cold weather, to fall as snow, or the static on a screen
core_image: 雪花静静地落满屋顶和树枝
scene: 大雪下了一整夜。The snow fell all night.
sceneCN: 这里 snow 是「雪」（第 1 个义项）；句意：大雪下了一整夜。

senses.title: Frozen white flakes
senses.definition: soft white pieces of frozen water that fall from clouds
senses.definitionCN: 从云中落下的柔软白色冰晶
senses.example: The snow fell all night.
senses.exampleCN: 大雪下了一整夜。
senses.why: This is the basic weather substance.
senses.whyCN: 这是基本的天气物质义项。

senses.title: Fall as snow
senses.definition: to fall from the sky as snow
senses.definitionCN: 以雪的形式从天而降
senses.example: It snowed for three days.
senses.exampleCN: 连着下了三天雪。
senses.why: The noun became a verb of weather.
senses.whyCN: 名词转化为天气动词。

senses.title: Static on a screen
senses.definition: black and white dots on a television or screen with no clear picture
senses.definitionCN: 电视或屏幕上没有清晰画面时的黑白噪点
senses.example: The old television showed only snow.
senses.exampleCN: 那台旧电视只显示雪花。
senses.why: Static looks like falling snow.
senses.whyCN: 静电噪点看起来像落雪。

intro.en: Snow comes from an Old English word of the same meaning.
intro.cn: snow 来自一个意思相同的古英语词。

items.en: Snaw meant snow.
The form became snow.
It named falling flakes.
The verb meant to fall as snow.
Snow also named screen static.
items.cn: snow 也指屏幕上的雪花。

note.en: Snow is compared with look-alike words and other cold weather.
note.cn: 把 snow 与形近词以及其他寒冷天气现象作比较。

entries.definition: a thin white layer of ice

normalIntro.en: Snow is winter's quiet white cover.
normalIntro.cn: snow 是冬天安静的白色覆盖。

normal.en: The snow fell all night.
It snowed for three days.
The old television showed only snow.
normal.cn: 那台旧电视只显示雪花。

normal.en: The roof was covered in snow.
Children built a snowman in the garden.
normal.cn: 孩子们在花园里堆了个雪人。

abstract.en: Snow makes the world quiet by covering its edges.
abstract.cn: 雪覆盖世界的棱角，让它安静下来。

abstract.en: No two flakes agree, yet they make one white field.
abstract.cn: 没有两片雪花相同，它们却铺成同一片白野。

abstract.en: Cold beauty disappears as soon as it is held.
abstract.cn: 冰冷的美一被握住就消失。

examples.en: The snow fell all night.
examples.cn: 大雪下了一整夜。

examples.en: It snowed for three days.
examples.cn: 连着下了三天雪。

examples.en: The old television showed only snow.
examples.cn: 那台旧电视只显示雪花。

dict_mnemonic.text: snow 与 slow、show、now 形近；heavy snow 是「大雪」，covered in snow 是「被雪覆盖」。

root: 由古英语 snaw（雪）演变而来，核心义「寒冷天气落下的白色冰晶」。

sensesIntro.en: Snow is frozen flakes, the weather that brings them, or screen static.
sensesIntro.cn: snow 指冻结的雪片、下雪的天气，或屏幕噪点。

core.en: Cold white flakes that cover the ground.
core.cn: 覆盖地面的寒冷白色冰晶。

branches.en: White flakes build a blanket.
The sky sends snow downward.
Static fills an empty screen.
The substance and the falling share one word.
Both make a white noise of dots.

intro.en: Snow builds words for winter weather and play.
intro.cn: snow 构成表示冬季天气和玩雪活动的词。

latinIntro.en: Snow is a native English word, not Latin.
latinIntro.cn: snow 是英语本族词，不是拉丁语。

items.example: They walked through a snowy street.
items.exampleCN: 他们走过一条积雪的街道。

items.example: The snowman had a carrot nose.
One snowflake landed on her glove.
items.exampleCN: 一片雪花落在她的手套上。

items.example: He threw a snowball at the tree.
